findings.surface: My KUDY history/settings storage on the emulator dev-client
findings.observed: History section answers with the localized unavailable state and a native-module error: "Call to function 'NativeDatabase.execSync' has been rejected." with causes "java.lang.NullPointerException" (de-my.png) and "database is locked" (de-my-font150.png) on different runs.
findings.consequence: The UI-language choice does not survive a force-stop relaunch on this build (relaunch returns the be chrome after a de selection); the durable settings row cannot be exercised through the same adapter.
findings.note: The app handles the failure gracefully (localized state + Erneut versuchen), no crash. Same-cause suspicion for the package-download failure (N2) needs a separate task; physical-device verification is blocked-external here.

findings.surface: Preview package download (synthetic e2e origin, be UI)
findings.observed: Tap Загрузіць on the free guide ends in the download-failed state (Паўтарыць + Збой загрузкі., be-synthetic-after-download.png); the same URLs answer 200 from the host (bundle/e2e-free-guide/1/be/base/lock.json). The walk start therefore stays unexercised in this environment.
findings.note: Correct refusal texts were proven on the paid demo route instead: "Патрэбна пакупка." (preview#purchase-required) after Пачаць with a purchased-gated route.

findings.observed: font_scale=1.5 set via adb settings, app force-stopped and relaunched: all eight self-name chips visible and tappable (font150-record.json, de-my-font150.png), font scale reset to 1.0 afterwards. The screenshot does not demonstrate visual 1.5x scaling of the app text (dev-client configuration propagation), so the scaling half of this check stays not-proven here and needs the physical-device record.
findings.note: The 2026-10-04 retest's 150% pass (kudy-font-150-clean.png) remains the prior evidence for the scaling half.
